requirements.description: Mouse gaze and directional wind drag are distinct and observable.
WASD moves/steps; Q/E turns; releases decay without snapping.
Walking changes body/hip/leg/foot parameters with support-foot lock <= 2 px.
Z/X/C/V trigger arm/hand actions and numeric keys select expressions.
Gamepad and mocap equivalent inputs participate in priority-based channel blending.
Randomized mixed inputs recover without non-finite state or console errors.
The UI teaches keyboard, gamepad, mocap and drag-to-wind interaction.
